text.tspan: Population density of the world's largest cities
Estimated number of people per km² of land area for cities ranked among the top 100 most populous in 2020.
City boundaries are defined using a consistent global approach based on satellite imagery and population data.

tspan.tspan: Because city boundaries follow a standardized global approach rather than national definitions, estimates may differ from official country
